covered_sections: Main PDF 1–2: rationale, bands and independent JUROGAM II run
Main PDF 3–6: compared angular-distribution branches, newly measured P/Rac and adopted delta, QTR and references
SI PDF 1–5: angular and polarization matrices, level scheme, background/gate spectra, sigma/I treatment, transition table
SI PDF 6–7: QTR components and methods references
key_anchors: SI PDF 1, Eqs. 1 and 2: shared all-angle gate, four angles pooled in two arms; polarization calibration.
Main PDF 3, Table 1: three published P/Rac/delta tuples; delta centres -0.47, -0.37, -0.31.
SI PDF 4: central P and Rac fix adopted delta and sigma/I; varying fixed widths for observational error propagation.
SI PDF 5, Table 1: asymmetry, energy, relative intensity and gate/line context.
publication_independence: Main and SI are one work. New JUROGAM data are independent from the reused Matta 2015 and Sensharma 2019 ATLAS angular-distribution points.
evidence_gaps: No numerical best-fit sigma/I, full scan grid or joint covariance is tabulated.
755.1 keV has angular ratio only; no new joint delta for this line or for the 550.9/518.6 keV links.
Earlier ATLAS data plotted for comparison retain their old provenance.
reader: Codex (reconciled existing source notes and original main/SI; Gemini gateway unavailable in prior probes)
